description: This file defines the 'AOS_Contracts' class, which extends 'AOS_Contracts_sugar'. It includes methods for managing contracts, such as saving, deleting, creating reminders, and linking calls. The class is part of the SuiteCRM module for handling contracts within the application.

classes.name: AOS_Contracts
classes.description: Represents a contract in SuiteCRM, extends core functionality with specific behaviors for reminders, linking calls, and managing associated entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new contract, sets default renewal reminder date based on configuration and end date if not already set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the contract record, manages related entities, and triggers reminder creation.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the contract and related entities as deleted.

methods.name: createReminder
methods.description: Creates a reminder call for contract renewal.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates a link (call) associated with the contract for renewal reminders.

methods.name: deleteCall
methods.description: Deletes the associated call for renewal reminder.
